name: Atarah
overview: Atarah is a female biblical figure identified primarily as the wife of Jerahmeel, as recorded in 1 Chronicles 2:26. There is no specific tribal affiliation or additional notes provided about her in Scripture. Her mention is brief and focused on her familial connection.
namesAndTitles: The name Atarah means "circlet" or "wreath," reflecting a proper name of Hebrew origin. This meaning may symbolize honor or distinction, though the name itself is not indicated as being given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Atarah as the wife of Jerahmeel and the mother of Onam, establishing her role within this family lineage. No other family relationships are documented beyond these connections.
scriptureSignificance: Atarah’s significance lies in her place within the genealogical records of 1 Chronicles, contributing to the understanding of the lineage of Jerahmeel. While not a central character in the biblical narrative, her mention preserves the heritage and continuity of the family line important to the biblical text.
